question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA', show the subject ID, department name, term description, and the running sum of total units within each academic year, along with the offering department name, offering school name, the number of unique subjects, and the minimum total units for each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    c.SUBJECT_ID,
    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    c.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    c.TOTAL_UNITS,
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON t.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
  JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
    ON tso.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
   AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID
  WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2022FA'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM TIP_DETAIL td
      WHERE td.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
        AND td.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID
        AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'
    )
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS UNIQUE_SUBJECTS,
    MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS MIN_TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM base
  GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
)
SELECT
  b.SUBJECT_ID,
  b.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  b.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  SUM(b.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY b.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY b.SUBJECT_ID) AS RUNNING_SUM_TOTAL_UNITS,
  b.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  b.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,
  a.UNIQUE_SUBJECTS,
  a.MIN_TOTAL_UNITS
FROM base b
JOIN agg a
  ON a.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = b.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
 AND a.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = b.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
ORDER BY b.SUBJECT_ID

WITH CourseCIPInfo AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6), DeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3), DeptSubjectCount AS (SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(ccs2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM DeptSubjectStats AS inner_cte JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccs2 ON ccs2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE) SELECT cci.COURSE, cci.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, cci.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cci.SCHOOL_NAME, cci.PROGRAM_CODE, cci.PROGRAM_TITLE, cci.CATEGORY_CODE, cci.CATEGORY_TITLE, cci.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, cci.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, cci.min_warehouse_load_date, dsc.max_lecture_units, dsc.TERM_START_DATE, dsc.num_subjects_offered FROM CourseCIPInfo AS cci JOIN DeptSubjectCount AS dsc ON cci.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cci.min_warehouse_load_date > '01-JAN-20' ORDER BY cci.CATEGORY_CODE

WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12), Subq2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.IS_MASTER_SECTION = 'Y' AND t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P'), CombinedSubjects AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS max_enrolled_students FROM Subq1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.max_enrolled_students FROM Subq2 AS s2) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, max_enrolled_students FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100), subq1 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0), subq2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS = inner_cte2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_enrolled, s1.num_unique_subjects, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_ID

WITH SubjectStats AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.TERM_CODE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.TERM_START_DATE) AS avg_academic_year FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS a ON ata.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2022FA'), MaterialStats AS (SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE NOT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.avg_academic_year, m.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.SUBJECT_ID, m.ISBN, m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, m.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, m.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, m.max_num_enrolled_students FROM SubjectStats AS s JOIN MaterialStats AS m ON s.TERM_CODE = m.TERM_CODE AND s.SUBJECT_TITLE = m.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, material_count, min_term_code FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS material_count, MIN(TERM_CODE) AS min_term_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ISBN, c.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), avg_units AS (SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ISBN, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS units_deviation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_units AS a ON i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = a.TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT s1.academic_year, s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.material_count, s1.min_term_code, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.ISBN, s2.units_deviation FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY s1.academic_year, s1.min_term_code

WITH DeptSchoolRQStats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME), LibrarySubjects2014FA AS (SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA') SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.window_column, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units FROM LibrarySubjects2014FA AS l JOIN DeptSchoolRQStats AS d ON l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = d.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lrmd.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS min_material_status, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_records FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lrmd.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_material_status, inner_cte.total_records, MAX(lrmd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_library_warehouse_date, MAX(td.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_tip_warehouse_date FROM inner_cte JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_material_status, inner_cte.total_records ORDER BY inner_cte.total_records DESC
